resources.string: Not set. Only for a car that drops the phone\'s Bluetooth, or hangs up, when myCar connects. With it, other cars may stop taking the phone\'s music over Bluetooth.

In Android\'s Settings > About phone (on some phones under Status): Bluetooth address. myCar tells it to a car already paired with the phone. Only for a car that drops the phone\'s Bluetooth, or hangs up, when myCar connects: other cars may then stop taking the phone\'s music over Bluetooth.
That isn\'t a Bluetooth address. It looks like 12:34:56:78:9A:BC.
%1$s. myCar doesn\'t tell it to cars that stopped taking the phone\'s music over Bluetooth with it.
myCar no longer tells the car the phone\'s address

The car took the phone\'s music over Bluetooth, but stopped once myCar told it the phone\'s Bluetooth address (Settings > Connection). myCar no longer tells it: from the next drive the music goes over Bluetooth again. If the car then drops the phone\'s Bluetooth, or hangs up, save the address again.
This car stopped taking the phone\'s music over Bluetooth once it knew the phone\'s address. myCar won\'t tell it again: from the next drive, the music goes over Bluetooth.
